Name: Krobus Gets Married (beta)
Author: scrotorrr
Description:
This is a beta version.  I'm working to flesh it all out, but wanted the world to have a glimpse of Krobus's new bride!

Do you love Krobus, but not want to keep him from love by making him your roommate?
Do you want to see Marlon and the Wizard bicker like an old married couple?
Do you want to see Linus dance?
What about a headbanging Wizard?

Well, my friend, all that is included in this beta version, so imagine the possibilities when the mod comes to life in the future!

The 3 mini events are complete and worked for me when I tested them along with about 159 other mods.
Krobus's dear wife has very VERY little dialogue so far, and I'm trying to figure out things like how to make Krobus un-roommate-able and how to let his wifey go to the movies.  But this is a beta version, so I still have time :)

If any of you are inspired to contribute to a fuller version of this mod, DM me.  I'm taking a few days off to rest my eyes and dream of finding love just like our favorite Shadow Person!

If anyone finds any glitches or bugs, please comment and I'll take a look when I can.
